about.text: The water-soluble form of casein. Acid casein curd is dissolved in a dilute alkali, usually sodium hydroxide (calcium, potassium and ammonium are also used), and the solution is spray-dried. Sodium caseinate is the most common form, valued as an emulsifier in processed meat, baking and dairy-based foods.
